title: Up On The Roof Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Incredible open air porches up and down that run the length of the home; upstairs porch has bed swing. Large open air roof top deck with stunning town and sunset views. Short walk to beach and across from West Side pool.
description_expanded: Description860 FOREST STREET4 QUEEN BEDSWelcome to Up on the Roof in Seaside, FloridaPerfectly positioned directly across from Seaside’s West End Pool, Up on the Roof offers a relaxed coastal retreat with multiple outdoor living spaces and thoughtful interiors designed for memorable family vacations. From its prime West End location to its rooftop views, this home blends comfort, convenience, and classic Seaside charm.Spacious Outdoor Living on Every LevelUp on the Roof welcomes guests with two expansive open-air porches on the first and second levels, ideal for soaking up the Florida sunshine. The first-floor porch features outdoor dining with a picnic table and adjacent Adirondack seating for four, creating a perfect setting for casual meals or morning coffee. A furnished rear porch just off the kitchen adds even more outdoor space to relax and unwind.Open-Concept Living, Dining & KitchenStep inside to an open floor plan designed for gathering and connection. The inviting living room offers comfortable seating and a large flat-screen TV, making it perfect for movie nights or game-day viewing. Just beyond, the dining area comfortably seats eight guests, with additional breakfast bar seating for three. The recently updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, new countertops, and everything needed to prepare meals with ease.First-Floor Bedroom & Full BathA queen bedroom is conveniently located just off the living area and includes a mounted flat-screen TV. A spacious full bathroom is located directly across the hall, serving both the bedroom and main living spaces on the first floor.Second-Floor Bedrooms & Front Porch RetreatThe second floor hosts three additional queen bedrooms and opens to a large, furnished front porch overlooking a peaceful wooded park area. The primary queen bedroom offers ample storage, private en suite bathroom, and direct access to the porch. The recently renovated primary bath features marble countertops and a marble rain shower. An adjacent queen bedroom also opens to the front porch, while the fourth queen bedroom is tucked away at the rear of the home. These bedrooms share a renovated full hall bath with a tub/shower combination.Iconic Seaside Porch LivingStretching the length of the home, the second-floor open-air porch is a true highlight. Enjoy lazy afternoons on the custom-built queen hanging bed or relax in the rocking chairs while taking in the tranquil views—an ideal space for unwinding after a day at the beach.Third-Floor Loft & Rooftop Deck ViewsAt the top of the home, a third-floor loft offers a built-in workspace with two desks, perfect for remote work or planning the day’s adventures. From here, step onto the open-air rooftop deck, furnished with seating for four and showcasing sweeping Seaside rooftop views with a glimpse of the Gulf. This elevated escape is the perfect spot for sunset cocktails or a peaceful nightcap under the stars.For more space, the rear guest cottage A Wrinkle in Time can be rented and sleeps an additional three.5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be FEATURES2,166 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at Natchez Pavilion3-minute (176-yard) walk to the beach, offering easy access to the GulfFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival, featuring 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking information: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitSTR23-002210
